title: MCP file tool accepts path argument that escapes containment boundary
abstract_chain: agent connects to MCP server with file-handling tools
tool argument contains a path outside the intended rules directory
server joins path without containment validation
file write reaches user-writable runtime location
defensive_focus: normalize and enforce base directory containment
reject absolute paths and traversal tokens
bind tool arguments to advertised schema
log model context, tool name, and normalized path
safety_note: Use inert file markers and mock MCP calls; do not write to real Python site-packages.

title: MCP vulnerability fix misses equivalent file-handling sink
abstract_chain: vendor patches one vulnerable MCP handler
equivalent handler or helper remains reachable
same trust boundary can be crossed through a different tool name
security test only covers original proof path
defensive_focus: variant analysis across all handlers
sink-based tests instead of PoC-only tests
coverage map for each file operation helper
regression tests for absolute and traversal paths
safety_note: Model patch coverage metadata; do not reproduce exploit payloads.

title: Hub manifest post_install field controls executable install step
abstract_chain: agent or developer installs a validator or plugin from a hub
hub manifest supplies post-install script path
installer executes script based on manifest data
installation environment contains project secrets or user credentials
defensive_focus: validate manifest fields against allowlist
disable install hooks by default
install plugins in credential-free sandbox
require signed manifests and package provenance
safety_note: Use synthetic manifests and no executable scripts.

title: ML framework dependency version is compromised and may harvest credentials
abstract_chain: notebook or training runner installs compromised ML framework version
package executes in environment with data and cloud credentials
credential harvesting behavior is possible
model and dataset pipeline artifacts become suspect
defensive_focus: pin known-clean versions
rebuild training images from clean base
rotate cloud, API, SSH, and service-account credentials
review notebook and runner logs for suspicious activity
safety_note: Use fake package names in lab; do not install compromised package versions.

title: Compromised database adapter packages harvest tokens and attempt self-propagation
abstract_chain: project installs compromised database adapter version
package lifecycle runs with access to npm, cloud, GitHub, or SSH credentials
credentials are harvested
package attempts propagation through publishing or maintainer permissions
defensive_focus: block known compromised versions
run npm install without publish tokens
monitor npm/GitHub token use after install
rotate all credentials accessible to affected machine
safety_note: Use local dummy registry events and fake tokens only.

title: Mastra-scope npm package compromise uses typosquat dependency and postinstall staging
abstract_chain: compromised scoped package introduces typosquat dependency
postinstall hook runs obfuscated JavaScript setup script
second stage uses script interpreter and in-memory loading
later stages inspect secrets, cloud metadata, or CI environment
defensive_focus: detect new lifecycle scripts and phantom dependencies
block typosquat dependency introduction
correlate Node.js, PowerShell, and suspicious .NET loading
monitor cloud metadata access from build agents
safety_note: Use staged benign commands and local telemetry; do not include real C2 or payload.

title: PeopleSoft management endpoint exploited before vendor advisory
abstract_chain: PeopleSoft Environment Management Hub endpoint is exposed
activity consistent with critical RCE occurs before public advisory
attacker obtains application-level foothold
data theft or extortion activity follows
defensive_focus: inventory and restrict management endpoints
monitor PSEMHUB requests and application process anomalies
hunt for pre-advisory access windows
prepare data access and export review
safety_note: Use abstract ERP logs; no exploit requests.

title: Vishing captures SSO credentials and MFA code then registers attacker device
abstract_chain: caller impersonates IT staff and claims MFA settings are being updated
victim enters SSO credentials and MFA code on branded phishing site
attacker registers new MFA device or obtains session
attacker accesses SaaS platforms and exports data based on victim permissions
defensive_focus: detect MFA device registration after risky session
monitor new device and impossible travel patterns
alert on SaaS bulk export and internal communications access
harden helpdesk and MFA reset workflows
safety_note: Use training simulations and synthetic SaaS logs only.

title: Agentic AI workflow manipulates task flow to bypass human approval
abstract_chain: agent decomposes user task into multiple steps
untrusted content alters the sequence or framing of actions
approval prompt omits risky downstream action or changes its meaning
tool call executes with user-granted authority
defensive_focus: show full action graph at approval time
bind approval to exact tool, arguments, and data destination
track provenance of plan changes
require reapproval when task flow mutates
safety_note: Use harmless tool calls and synthetic approval records.

title: Compromised VPN access followed by user-writable directory tooling and privilege reconnaissance
abstract_chain: remote access appears through suspected compromised VPN credentials
tools are staged in user-writable directories
hands-on-keyboard commands enumerate privileges and cached credentials
follow-on tunneling or lateral movement begins
defensive_focus: correlate VPN source with endpoint process activity
alert on binaries in Pictures or Downloads subfolders
detect privilege reconnaissance commands
contain sessions with suspicious VPN and local tooling overlap
safety_note: Use benign command names and synthetic process logs.

title: AI-branded phishing lure abuses user trust in popular AI services
abstract_chain: email or landing page impersonates a popular AI brand
victim is asked to login, update payment, or verify account
phishing page collects personal or payment data
campaign reuses AI hype to raise click-through and trust
defensive_focus: brand impersonation detection
user training for AI-themed lures
URL and domain similarity checks
payment data loss monitoring

title: AI/Agent dependency executes before policy engine can inspect runtime action
abstract_chain: agent platform relies on runtime policy to govern tool actions
dependency install or import executes before agent policy is active
malicious package accesses secrets or modifies environment
later runtime policy sees only normal agent behavior
defensive_focus: shift controls to install and import phases
run dependency setup in sealed sandbox
withhold secrets until dependency validation completes
record pre-runtime process and network telemetry
safety_note: Use synthetic lifecycle events and no real malicious dependency.
